title: NexAC Proxy Handler
description: The proxy server handler for NexAC.
body:
To use NexAC, you're going to need this proxy handler. It provides the backend for your proxy server and makes it all possible.

Current supported proxy types:
- Velocity

Coming supported proxy types:
- BungeeCord

For the main plugin, head to https://modrinth.com/plugin/nexac.

# Setup
- This plugin must be installed in your main server's plugins folder.
- The velocity plugin, which you can get from https://modrinth.com/plugin/nexac, goes in all your subserver's plugins folder.
